description:
Brand introduction:
Jones Ranch Coffee is a premium coffee brand specializing in sustainably sourced, single-origin coffees from Central and South America. We focus on quality, transparency, and a direct relationship with farmers.

Product description:
We offer high-quality roasted beans, including our flagship Saludos coffee, Tinto de Sevilla, and Pacamara Select. Each bag tells a story of origin and craftsmanship.

USP (Unique Selling Point):
Our coffee is traceable, 100% sustainable, and crafted for discerning coffee drinkers. We bypass cooperatives and auctions to work directly with select farms.

Payment terms:
Affiliates receive a 15% commission on every qualifying sale. Payments are processed monthly through PayPal, with a minimum payout threshold of $50.

Other information:
Affiliates gain access to professional media assets, tracking tools, and seasonal campaigns. Top performers are eligible for exclusive bonuses and first access to limited releases.

Jones Ranch Coffee Company Ambassador Program Terms and Conditions

1. Ambassador Program Overview

The Jones Ranch Coffee Company (JRC) Ambassador Program allows approved Ambassadors to earn commissions on qualifying sales referred to JRC through their unique Ambassador links. By participating in the Ambassador Program, you agree to abide by the following terms and conditions.

2. Ambassador Enrollment

To enroll in the Ambassador Program, you must submit a completed application. All applications are subject to review, and we reserve the right to accept or reject any application at our discretion.

3. Commissions

Ambassadors will earn a 10% commission on the total net sale value (excluding taxes, shipping costs, and any discounts) for qualifying purchases made by customers who use their Ambassador link. Commissions are paid only on sales that are tracked through our platform and fall within the 30-day cookie window.

  • Net Sale Value: The amount of the sale after all applicable discounts, coupons, or promotional offers are applied, excluding taxes and shipping.
  • Exclusions: No commissions will be earned on returns, chargebacks, or refunded sales.

4. Cookie Tracking

When a customer clicks your Ambassador link, a cookie is placed in their browser, which is valid for 30 days. If the customer completes a purchase within this 30-day period, you will be credited for the sale. However, if the customer clicks another Ambassador's link before completing the purchase, the commission will be attributed to the last link clicked, and you may not be credited for the sale.

5. Payouts

Commissions will be paid once you have reached the minimum payout threshold of $50. Payments will be made via the payment method selected during enrollment. Any returns or cancellations that occur after a commission has been paid will be deducted from future payouts.

  • Payment Schedule: Payouts are processed on a monthly basis, typically by the 15th of each month.

6. Prohibited Activities

Ambassadors are prohibited from:

  • Engaging in any form of spamming, including posting Ambassador links on any unsolicited emails, messages, or comments.
  • Using unauthorized advertising methods, such as Pay-Per-Click (PPC) bidding on Jones Ranch Coffee’s brand name or domain.
  • Misrepresenting JRC or making false claims about the product.
  • Using fraudulent methods to generate sales, such as using bots or generating false traffic.

If we detect any prohibited activity, we reserve the right to terminate your Ambassador account and forfeit any pending commissions.

7. Ambassador Link Usage

Ambassador links must be properly formatted using the platform provided by JRC. Failure to properly format the link may result in non-crediting of the sale, for which JRC will not be held responsible.

8. Modification of Terms

JRC reserves the right to update or modify these terms and conditions at any time. Ambassadors will be notified of any significant changes, and continued participation in the program will constitute acceptance of the new terms.

9. Termination

JRC reserves the right to terminate your participation in the Ambassador Program at any time, with or without cause. Reasons for termination may include but are not limited to:

  • Violation of these terms and conditions.
  • Engagement in any prohibited activities listed above.
  • Failure to meet minimum performance standards.

Upon termination, any unpaid commissions will be forfeited if the termination was due to a violation of these terms.

10. Independent Contractor Relationship

By participating in the Ambassador Program, you acknowledge that you are an independent contractor. Nothing in this agreement creates any partnership, joint venture, employment, or agency relationship between you and JRC.

11. Limitation of Liability

Jones Ranch Coffee is not liable for any indirect, special, or consequential damages arising in connection with the Ambassador Program or this agreement. We make no express or implied warranties regarding the Ambassador Program, including warranties of fitness, merchantability, or non-infringement.

12. Governing Law

These terms and conditions are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Texas, without regard to its conflict of laws principles. Any disputes arising under this agreement will be resolved exclusively in the state and federal courts located in Cameron County, Texas.

13. Agreement

By applying to and participating in the JRC Ambassador Program, you acknowledge that you have read and agree to the terms and conditions outlined above.
